profile_headline: Looking For Job Change in HR
post_content:
Bad mouthing your current employer can block your future job opportunities ? I
see a lot of linkedIN posts saying they rejected a candidate because they
mentioned certain mishaps in their current company which made them look
disloyal. • The environment of our company is not so good. • I didn't get my
salary on time. • My boss is among the cruelest ones. • Due to overburden. •
Because they don't allow me to take a single leave. • Because the company is
not so good. • There is no management. All mentioned 7 points above are
possible scenarios for anyone. The bitter truth is such things exist. So,
Should we try to be more empathetic and appreciate candidate honesty OR be
more practical and lead from the data? What would you have done? After all,
Employees are now human capital for an organization. hashtag#HR
